query:
Both Theo and Nneka said they would not attend the fair as part of the group. Who gave speed or efficiency as their reason for preferring to go alone?

Options:
A. Gil
B. Nneka
C. Preet
D. Rashida
context:
[1] (about=Nneka, episodic, t0 @2025-04-07T21:04:00) I move faster alone.
[2] (about=Nneka, episodic, t0 @2025-04-07T21:02:00) Going alone. Will share if I find something relevant.
[3] (about=Theo, episodic, t0 @2025-04-07T21:06:00) Nneka is correct. Group fairs are slower.
[4] (about=Nneka, episodic, t6 @2025-04-28T21:14:00) Going alone regardless.
[5] (about=Rashida, episodic, t0 @2025-04-07T20:26:00) Theo don't 😂🎶 just come and enjoy the fair
[6] (about=Rashida, episodic, t0 @2025-04-07T20:14:00) Fitzroy Record Fair is back! First Sunday of next month 🎶 who's in?
[7] (about=Rashida, episodic, t5 @2025-04-28T19:58:00) Camden Record Fair next month! Big one 🎶 full day sellers, about 80 stalls. Who's in?
[8] (about=Theo, episodic, t2 @2025-04-14T18:07:00) Rashida what were the four.
[9] (about=Rashida, episodic, t2 @2025-04-14T18:12:00) ok last fair for a while honestly. I need to behave myself 😂 setting a budget for the next one

agent_answer: B. Nneka — she said “I move faster alone.”
